title: Alec van Helsdingen
text:
I recently completed a PhD student in statistics at the University of Auckland, focusing on stochastic processes and ecology.
A large part of my thesis is devoted to Spatial Capture-Recapture (SCR) models, which are widely used for estimating the size of animal populations. My work modifies SCR models to better account for the movement of individual animals in camera trapping surveys. Another focus has been modelling temporal point patterns where there is dependence between points (i.e. the Poisson assumptions are inappropriate). The times of whale cues served as a motivation, since these tend to be more “metronomic” than otherwise expected.
I’ve also worked with Hidden Markov Models (HMMs) and problems in operations research such as integer programming.
This website contains my election forecasts for New Zealand, the Netherlands and Ireland.
I’m also a genealogist and genetic genealogist, and have another website with transcription of Dutch historical records.

title: New Zealand
text:
Government Formation
We consider eight possible outcomes for government formation, from Labour winning a majority on its own, to National doing the same. We do not consider the possibility of coalitions between parties in the current government and current opposition. Every possible election result, assuming no other parties win seats and that National or Labour will lead the next government, falls into exactly one of these outcomes.
